description: HIFLD Open Local Roads is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Census Bureau et al.). Local Roads include roads that have the following MTFCCs:S1400 Local Neighborhood Road, Rural Road, City StreetS1500 Vehicular Trail (4WD)S1630 RampS1640 Service Drive usually along a limited access highwayS1710 Walkway/Pedestrian TrailS1720 StairwayS1730 AlleyS1740 Private Road for service vehicles (logging, oil fields, ranches, etc.)S1750 Internal U.S. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
